author: Intel
description:
The Princeton-Intel Research Experience for Undergraduates gives talented students the opportunity to explore cybersecurity research alongside leading professors and industry researchers. Through hands-on experience and dedicated mentorship, students strengthen their technical skills, develop independence, learn to tackle questions without established answers, and discover new possibilities for their futures. See how Princeton and Intel are working together to expand access to research and invest in the next generation of security leaders.
 
Subscribe now to Intel on YouTube: https://intel.ly/3IX1bN2
